$$\text{Wait, let us check: } 35 d_1 = 70 \implies d_1 = 2$$

hints: For $N = 142$, the median position is $\frac{142}{2} = 71$. Determine which class contains this value and apply linear interpolation.
Find the lower quartile $Q_1$ at position $\frac{142}{4} = 35.5$, which lies in Class 2 ($35 \le m < 45$).
Find the upper quartile $Q_3$ at position $3 \times 35.5 = 106.5$, which lies in Class 3 ($45 \le m < 60$).
Calculate $\text{IQR} = Q_3 - Q_1$.

walkthrough.text:
Find the median ($Q_2$) at position $71$:
$$\text{Cumulative frequencies: } F(35) = 30, \quad F(45) = 70, \quad F(60) = 118$$
$$\text{Position } 71 \text{ lies in } 45 \le m < 60:$$
$$Q_2 = 45 + \frac{71 - 70}{48} \times 15 = 45 + \frac{1}{48} \times 15 = 45 + 0.3125 = 45.3125 \approx 45.3\text{ g}$$

Find $Q_1$ and $Q_3$ using linear interpolation:
$$\text{Position } Q_1 = 35.5 \text{ lies in } 35 \le m < 45:$$
$$Q_1 = 35 + \frac{35.5 - 30}{40} \times 10 = 35 + \frac{5.5}{40} \times 10 = 35 + 1.375 = 36.375\text{ g}$$
$$\text{Position } Q_3 = 106.5 \text{ lies in } 45 \le m < 60:$$
$$Q_3 = 45 + \frac{106.5 - 70}{48} \times 15 = 45 + \frac{36.5}{48} \times 15 = 45 + 11.40625 = 56.40625\text{ g}$$

Calculate the interquartile range:
$$\text{IQR} = Q_3 - Q_1 = 56.40625 - 36.375 = 20.03125 \approx 20.0\text{ g}$$

ai_rubric.observable: Applies linear interpolation for median at position $71$: $45 + \frac{1}{48} \times 15 \approx 45.3\text{ g}$.
